definitions.gloss: dual use; usable for both purposes
definitions.explanation: Serving two purposes or working in two settings, usually named by the pair of nouns before it: {遠近|えんきん}{両用|りょうよう}, {水陸|すいりく}{両用|りょうよう}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遠近|えんきん}→遠近：08124_enkin⟧{両用|りょうよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{眼鏡|めがね}→眼鏡：00651_megane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
{水陸|すいりく}{両用|りょうよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}った→渡る：02441_wataru⟧。
examples.english: We crossed the river in an amphibious vehicle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遠近|えんきん}→遠近：08124_enkin⟧{両用|りょうよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コンタクトレンズ→コンタクトレンズ：17011_kontakutorenzu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
examples.english: There are also multifocal contact lenses, but they take a while to get used to.

notes:
Almost always follows a pair of nouns naming the two uses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{遠近|えんきん}→遠近：08124_enkin⟧{両用|りょうよう}: for both near and far (progressive or bifocal lenses)
- {水陸|すいりく}{両用|りょうよう}: amphibious
- {軍民|ぐんみん}{両用|りょうよう}: dual-use (military and civilian technology)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{兼用|けんよう}→兼用：15781_kenyou⟧: one item doing two jobs or shared by two groups (⟦{男女|だんじょ}→男女：03117_danjo⟧⟦{兼用|けんよう}→兼用：15781_kenyou⟧, ⟦{晴雨|せいう}{兼用|けんよう}→晴雨兼用：28591_seiukenyou⟧); the more everyday word
